selection_rule: This engineering preflight is frozen before receptor-authority results are inspected. The named odorants are a smoke-test panel, not the preregistered production E003b selection set. Production odorants must be selected by receptor-data coverage/diversity before behavior or intact-vs-rewire results are observed.
claim_boundary: This config exercises the vector-odor world and receptor front end. It cannot qualify E003b or support a MaleCNS odor-identification/navigation claim.
